releases.name: 3 Romance Kingdoms
releases.summary:
"Romance of the Three Kingdoms" is a unique Three Kingdoms-themed strategy card game with a Chinese style. It uses a 3x3 grid for character positioning and skill casting with chanting. 

Here, you will recruit skilled generals to form a dream team and challenge famous generals from the Three Kingdoms period with diverse styles.

releases.name: Guardian of soul tower
releases.summary: Fight in real-time, build powerful elemental decks, and climb the Soul Tower in this dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Every death leaves behind a Nemesis Phantom created from your own deck, waiting to challenge you in future runs.

releases.name: Guidance in Islam
releases.summary: Grow your faith daily! Enjoy fun Islamic quizzes, easy lessons, the complete Digital Quran & Daily Challenges. Build streaks, earn rewards and duel other people in a friendly way based on your knowledge.

releases.name: Asobutsuri
releases.summary: Place items freely in a virtual space, harness the laws of physics, and build your own Rube Goldberg-style contraptions. Design your contraption, press the Action Button, and enjoy the thrill of watching it come to life. A built-in Stage Editor lets you create your own original stages.

releases.name: Battle Of Plans
releases.summary: Weekly Clan Wars are live! Join your clan, climb the bracket, and battle for epic rewards. Collect mythic heroes and build your ultimate army today!

releases.name: East
releases.summary: "East" is a military-themed tower defense PC game. The game is based on the personal experiences of Guo Xiang from the novel as he participates in the Korean War, telling the story of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army fighting fearlessly to liberate Korea.

releases.name: PuruPuru: Pull It Along
releases.summary: Grab squishy little Purupuru with your mouse, stre-e-etch, and climb. It clings to walls and ceilings like a dewdrop. When the thread snaps, off it flies. The bigger the pull, the bigger the jump. Fall and your height is gone, but there's no game over. Play Solo or 4-player online Delivery Climb.

releases.name: Kingdom of the Beast: CAT
releases.summary: An immersive narrative game with dark humor. In Harbor City, a metropolis of desire and crime, rise from an art gallery assistant to the eye of the storm. In a nation where everyone is alienated into beasts, will you be a stray cat, staying lucid and watching coldly?

releases.name: MODIFY
releases.summary: MODIFY is a top-down puzzle game featuring a variety of abilities to change the attributes of objects to your advantage. Every object has a purpose. Every property can change.

releases.name: Doomsday War Maiden: Wasteland Awakening
releases.summary: 全球華人專屬！末日廢墟×日系萌娘，打造你的最強戰姬軍團！這是一款獸娘，機械妹，克蘇魯，福利拉滿的美少女養成策略卡牌遊戲！

releases.name: Internet Survivor * Survivors
releases.summary: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

releases.name: Lunch Break Dodgeball
releases.summary: Physics-based online dodgeball for 2–24 players. Create public or password-protected rooms, invite friends, customize your character with paint, and practice offline in 12-vs-12 training matches set in a schoolyard or gym.

releases.name: Chained Horror Experiences ~ AT THE THE CATTY PARK ~
releases.summary: This is a point-and-click horror game set in a world inspired by modern Japan! The story is a work of fiction blending ghosts and occult elements. The game is controlled exclusively using the mouse; keyboard input is not supported.

releases.name: Sun Ultimate War
releases.summary: If you're a Tower Defense Game fan, you CANNOT miss Sun Ultimate War! Unleash ultimate plants: Watermelon Cannon, Abyss Demon, Doom Knight Mushroom. Melt dark army with Supreme Nuke & Abyss Death Ray. Defend camp. Let Milky Way burn! Let sea of stars boil! Wishlist now and command your solar legion

releases.name: Chinese Street Food Legend
releases.summary: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person’s life.

releases.name: Lootbound
releases.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

releases.name: Typing With Ghostie
releases.summary: A cute little Ghostie game that helps you type!

releases.name: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef
releases.summary:
In the bleak 1920s, luck abandons you, gripped by debt and entangled by the local gangster, Mr. Blackwood. Your path veers to the accursed seaside town of Innsmouth, where a hidden treasure is rumored to lie within Devil Reef.

What is thought to be an effortless treasure hunt changes fast as you venture deeper, amassing gold. The once-promising labyrinth reveals its sinister nature. Corridors contort, and eldritch horrors multiply, presenting a daunting challenge. 

Are you strong enough to reach the mythic treasure at the bottom of Devil Reef?

releases.name: Death Kitchen
releases.summary: Death Kitchen is a fast-paced online co-op horror cooking game. Decide between a chef and a waiter, then coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you if you make a mistake. Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.

releases.name: PizzaBoy
releases.summary: Take control of PizzaBoy as he delivers pizza to monsters in this precision platformer. Use all of PizzaBoy's smooth and snappy moves to navigate through dangerous levels or break away from the path to discover who PizzaBoy really is...
